summary: Attacked the round-5 task (assemble the degree-11 spline numerator N_6 as base + single-wall truncated powers, in leg variables). Headline result: the simple single-wall truncated-power form FAILS - N_6 is a GENUINE BOX SPLINE with cross-terms, correcting the round-5 task premise. I nonetheless extracted the (1=2) jump coefficient Q explicitly and exactly (the (1=2) sector IS a clean chamber-independent truncated power); the (1=1) sector carries chamber-dependent cross-terms organized by the perfect-matching geometry. All exact-rational against my own bg.cpp (shared untouched), cross-checked by an independent native-Python BG port.
work_done: Built fast infrastructure: added a guarded --batch mode to my OWN bg.cpp copy (exact GMP, per-point ZeroDiv guard so wall-hits don't SIGFPE-abort a batch); wrote pybg.py, a faithful native-Python BG port that reproduces ./bg EXACTLY at n=5,6,7 (independent second evaluator).
Re-confirmed the kink locus: same-type orderings (omega_i=omega_j within a triple) are ANALYTIC; only the mixed (1=1) and (1=2) walls carry kinks (_sametype.py).

EXTRACTED the (1=2) jump coefficient Q exactly (s1_015): degree-5, odd, H'-symmetric. Method: exact reconstruction of single-(1=2)-wall jumps on F-const slices, relabelled to a reference wall by S_3xS_3, fit deg-5 H'-sym (rank 34, consistent, held-out clean, 0/55 exact mismatches). Q = A2 B1 (y^2 - A1^2 - A1 B1 + A2 - B2) + B2 y (A2 - B1 y - B2) with A1,A2 (other 2 minus), B1,B2 (the plus pair), y (excluded plus).
GLOBAL validation of Q: M = N - sum_{(1=2)} (k_ijk)_+^3 Q_ijk is exactly (1=2)-SMOOTH (jump=0) at 10/10 (1=2) walls across >=4 chamber types (r5_corr.py, r5_verify.py).

PROVED the simple form fails / N is a box spline (s1_014): fit M against the COMPLETE basis (12 G-sym odd deg-11 invariant base classes + 125 manifold-independent deg-9 (1=1) templates, orbit-summed over the 9 walls = 137 columns). Real M -> FULL rank 137 but INCONSISTENT (r5_Mfit.py). CONTROL: a synthetic simple (1=1) spline through the SAME fitter -> CONSISTENT (r5_control.py), so the machinery is sound and the inconsistency is genuine.

Exhibited an explicit nonzero mixed second-difference (cross-term) at a (1=1)x(1=1) intersection (r5_crossterm.py); the chosen difference-branch walls force a third (a_2=b_4 & a_3=b_5 => a_1=b_6), tying cross-terms to the perfect-MATCHING geometry (s1_016).
Recorded claims s1_014/015/016, decisions s1_dec_009/010, derivation derivations/n6_round5_boxspline_and_Q.md.
